note: Per-source license floor for Shono. Shono never commits or redistributes raw audio regardless of these flags; `redistributable_audio` records what each source's own license permits, so a release check can double-check obligations. `status`: active = in the train/eval mix; eval-only = used for evaluation only, never training; excluded = not used until its blocker clears. Facts carry a per-fact confidence; commercial/pricing facts are the most perishable (re-verify after 2026-10-15).

licenses.access: Mozilla Data Collective (account + ToS) since Oct 2025; official HF repos emptied; community mirror fsicoli/common_voice_22_0 as fallback
licenses.notes: 54.32 h validated of 1277.5 h recorded, ~1.05M clips. Public-domain dedication (CC0).

licenses.name: OpenSLR SLR53 (Bengali ASR, Google)
licenses.notes: ~196k utterances (215-229 h secondary estimates). Share-alike: derivative distributions inherit CC-BY-SA. Quality-checked but residual errors possible.

licenses.name: Bengali-Loop (long-form + diarization benchmark)
licenses.access: Annotations + YouTube links published by the authors; audio NOT redistributed — fetch from source links
licenses.notes: CC-BY-4.0 covers the annotations only; audio stays at source (links + transcripts + scripts). 191 recordings/158.6 h ASR + 24 recordings/22 h diarization (5744 speaker segments). Published baselines: tugstugi medium 34.07% WER, pyannote out-of-box 40.08% DER.

licenses.name: MUCS 2021 / OpenSLR SLR104 (Bengali-English code-switch)
licenses.notes: 46.11 h train + 7.02 h test, technical-lecture domain. The only sizeable real Bn-En code-switch corpus; everything else is synthetic or command-only. Share-alike.

licenses.name: FLEURS Bengali (Google)
licenses.notes: Read-speech eval benchmark; ~10 h/language. Eval-only — never in the training mix. Reference point: zero-shot large-v3 ~33.9% WER on Bengali FLEURS.

licenses.access: Built in-project: audio strictly local/Kaggle-private; only links + timestamps + corrected transcripts + scoring scripts ever published, with a takedown path
licenses.notes: Eval-only, never training data. Publishing the manifest requires an explicit release decision. Legal basis: BD Copyright Act 2023 & India s.52(1)(a) research fair-dealing (M-confidence; not legal advice).
